target_claim: If $a_n$ is a sequence satisfying a linear recurrence then $\limsup_{n \to \infty} \sqrt[n]{|a_n|} = r$ exists and is equal to the absolute value of the largest root of the characteristic polynomial of the recurrence. The above argument (suitably tightened up) shows that $\lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt[n]{v_n} = 1$, so the roots of the characteristic polynomial have absolute value $\le 1$.
